name: blender chocolate chip cookie model and render
goal: Model a cookie with chips on a tray, assign materials, light with an Area light, frame camera, and render.

outputs.name: rendered_image
outputs.description: Saved render of cookie on tray

constraints: Ctrl+L Link Materials after multi-selecting chips (active = last selected)
Uncheck Lock Camera to View after framing

steps.action: Object mode: add Cylinder as cookie base (Shift while drawing for 1:1 circle); scale Z flatter; right-click Shade Smooth; rename to cookie.
Shift+A → Mesh → UV Sphere for a chip; S scale; G then Z place into cookie; Shade Smooth; Shift+D duplicate many chips.
Add thin Cube tray (Shift for square); Tab Edit mode; face select top; I inset; Extrude region downward for tray lip; Tab Object mode; position under cookie.
Select cookie → Material Properties → New → set Base Color (eyedropper optional); switch Viewport to Material Preview.
Select one chip → set dark Base Color; Shift-select all chips ending on the colored one; Ctrl+L → Link Materials.
Material on tray (e.g. blue). Delete default light; Shift+A → Light → Area; raise Power (~800–850), lower temperature (~4000K); move/rotate to light cookie.
Numpad 0 camera view; N → View → Lock Camera to View; compose shot; uncheck Lock Camera to View.
Render Properties: choose Eevee or Cycles (GPU if available); Render → Render Image (F12); Image → Save As.
